scope: Saved c12.5 a4.5 article results; numerical supplement explicitly separate from original run

field_interpretation.scope: bare MNP uniform-field formulas, no QD back-action; sampled pulse thresholds reported separately

ranking.allowance_definition: max(declared threshold tolerance, observed refinement changes); conservative resolution allowance, not a statistical confidence interval
ranking.separation_definition: every candidate outside the resolution plateau is worse than the winner by more than the allowance
ranking.scope: configured discrete candidates and one-parameter sensitivity cases only; no global or ensemble optimum

units.json.scope: one-MNP adaptation; intrinsic QD decay, no imported dimer Purcell rate

definitions.pulse_width: intensity FWHM, not field FWHM or sigma

model_error_estimates.scope: diagnostic indicators only; not used by any solver or acceptance gate
model_error_estimates.retardation_method: Meier-Wokaun long-wavelength correction, l = semi-axis along E
model_error_estimates.surface_damping_method: Drude term with hbar*gamma -> hbar*gamma + A*hbar*v_F/L_eff, L_eff = 4V/S

units.json.applicability: point QD/local electrostatics only; finite-QD field variation, nonlocality, and ensemble effects are not certified

quality_gates.note: N=1 may miss accuracy; passivity and stability remain mandatory

s1_repaired/weak_linear_audit.json.scope: weak-pulse Fourier response versus independent linear frequency-domain solution, same N12 fit

tip_side_audit/audit.json.scope: nominal local-QS model; no assertion of full-wave or finite-QD validity

tip_side_audit/frequency_fit_check.json.scope: N=13 time-domain fitted/reduced frequency response vs unreduced n=160 kernel with tabulated gold; frequency-domain check only

tip_side_audit/threshold_comparison.json.scope: nominal first-branch population thresholds; same physical inputs
